changes: Post-close now preserves a non-completed D0/D1 status instead of reporting COMPLETED.
BLOCKED D0/D1 results map to BLOCKED_D0_D1_INPUT and retain reason and snapshot_coverage.
Successful D0/D1 receipts expose snapshot_coverage at the post-close top level.
acceptance: A stale or incomplete close snapshot cannot produce a post-close success receipt or a price-forwarded plan.
